# Tool Library

The language of lending tools to the members of one neighbourhood.

## Language

**Member**:
A person who registered at the desk and can borrow tools.
_Avoid_: User, customer

**Tool**:
One physical item that the library lends.
_Avoid_: Item, product

**Reservation**:
A promise to hold one tool for one member until a pickup time.
_Avoid_: Booking, order

**Loan**:
The period in which a member holds a tool, from pickup to return.
_Avoid_: Rental, checkout
